messages:
maria_ops: quick heads-up — vendor emailed a revised ship plan for the EU H100 top-off. looks like lead time moved from 9d -> 16d for the remaining 24 units. can we re-prioritize allocations?
vikram_vendor: sorry for the churn, customs backlog in FRA pushed a couple waves. we can split 12 air now, 12 sea later. pricing delta: air +€1,800/unit, sea baseline.
sophie_logistics: if we do split, need to confirm AWB and depot handoff windows. air arrival tentative `AWB: EY1234567890` into AMS, depot slot 2026-07-25 AM. sea batch ETA 2026-08-10 via Rotterdam.
maria_ops: @tyler_procure is that extra air premium acceptable vs pushing more load to Dedicated pool and using warm spares?
tyler_procure: rough numbers: Air premium for 12 = €21.6k total. If we shift traffic to Dedicated warm pool we'd incur ~2 weeks extra latency on provisioning but save the uplift. preference: keep 8 on air (critical customers), move 4 into warm-spare rotation.
vikram_vendor: we can pre-authorize 8 air now. For the 4 warm-spare, vendor can tag them as "priority reserve" but requires a 30% deposit on the PO.
maria_ops: deposit note logged. what's the RMA plan if any of the air units are DOA? we don't have cycle buffer in AMS depot.
sophie_logistics: RMA flow: vendor will provide temporary loaners for DOA within 48h for air shipments (per contract), but shipping of replacements uses vendor RMA manifest. need HS code confirmation and proof-of-damage photos at depot.
rma-bot: automated: Vendor RMA SLA = 72h replacement commit after DOA confirmation. Upload evidence to rma.redwood/s/1798765430.
vikram_vendor: also flag — insurance clause: claims > €50k require forwarder sign-off, else vendor covers. if we route air to AMS we cross that threshold for full-loss scenarios; recommend adding transit insurance line on PO.
tyler_procure: add transit insurance. procurement will add `INS: transit+all-risk` on PO. what's the final delivery window if we go with 8 air + 4 reserve warm-spare + 12 sea?
sophie_logistics: final ETA summary: 8 air -> 2026-07-25; 4 reserve warm-spare -> vendor staging, available 2026-07-28 for crossdock; 12 sea -> 2026-08-10.
maria_ops: action items: 1) @vikram_vendor confirm deposit invoice for 4 reserve units by EOD; 2) @tyler_procure add insurance line + approve air premium for 8 units; 3) @sophie_logistics provide depot SOP for DOA intake (photo checklist + `manifest.csv` template).
vikram_vendor: invoice pinged to finance@redwood, estimate invoice id `INV-5298`. deposit due net 7.
tyler_procure: approved air premium for 8 units, finance to finalize payment.
sophie_logistics: uploading SOP snippet here:
```
DOA intake checklist:
- seal photo (box id)
- serial vs PO compare
- power-on test (15m)
- photo of failed POST logs
- attach `manifest.csv` with AWB and serials
```

sophie_logistics: will also provide temporary depot tag for quick routing: `DEPOT: AMS-WARM-3`.
maria_ops: also: any network constraints on bringing these into EU clusters? our EU edge has two spare racks but need power scheduling during Thursday maintenance window. if arrivals slip, capacity scheduling will break.
tyler_procure: I'll coordinate with infra to shift power window or delay non-critical deploys. estimate we can free one rack by shifting jobs to Dedicated for 48h.
vikram_vendor: final note on pricing: vendor will honor baseline unit price for sea batch, air batch will have the uplift listed as `freight surcharge` on the invoice so billing maps cleanly to cost centers.
maria_ops: perfect. last ask — can vendor pre-tag serials in the manifest so we can pre-load golden images? saves ~45m per unit at depot.
vikram_vendor: yes, we can include pre-tagging metadata in `manifest.csv` (column `preload=ubuntu-24.04-golden-v2`). will send sample manifest in next email.
maria_ops: thanks all. i'll file this thread into the provisioning playbook and update the pool allocations sheet. ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
